mapper.select: SELECT s.sgg_nm AS sggName, h.hjd_nm AS hjdNm FROM hjd h JOIN sgg s ON h.sgg_cd = s.sgg_cd ORDER BY s.sgg_nm, h.hjd_nm
SELECT b.hjd_cd, a.adstrd_nm FROM hjd_boundary b JOIN adstrd a ON b.hjd_cd = a.adstrd_cd WHERE ST_Contains(b.geom, ST_SRID(POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)) LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(ST_Y(ST_PointN(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(ST_SRID(geom, 0))), 1))) AS swLat, MIN(ST_X(ST_PointN(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(ST_SRID(geom, 0))), 1))) AS swLng, MAX(ST_Y(ST_PointN(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(ST_SRID(geom, 0))), 3))) AS neLat, MAX(ST_X(ST_PointN(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(ST_SRID(geom, 0))), 3))) AS neLng FROM hjd_boundary WHERE hjd_nm LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR sgg_nm = #{keyword} HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

SELECT MIN(ST_Y(ST_PointN(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(ST_SRID(geom, 0))), 1))) AS swLat, MIN(ST_X(ST_PointN(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(ST_SRID(geom, 0))), 1))) AS swLng, MAX(ST_Y(ST_PointN(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(ST_SRID(geom, 0))), 3))) AS neLat, MAX(ST_X(ST_PointN(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(ST_SRID(geom, 0))), 3))) AS neLng FROM hjd_boundary WHERE hjd_cd = #{hjdCd} HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
